_comment: Pinned worker image digests. Keyed by the catalog image ref (see model_catalog). Install pulls by digest and verifies, so a repointed tag cannot substitute a different image. Regenerated by scripts/build-workers.sh on push; third-party images are pinned to a reviewed digest by hand. Unlisted images (not yet published) fall back to their tag unless CLOUDIY_REQUIRE_PINNED_IMAGES is set.
